summary: Declared the Playwright MCP server in Nix: a new npx-wrapper package reusing the cached ~/.cache/ms-playwright Chromium via --executable-path, registered in the overlay/home.packages, plus a merge-only home.activation block registering mcpServers.playwright in ~/.claude.json without touching lean-lsp or other keys. All 6 phases completed; flake check, home-manager build/switch (twice, idempotent), and a live navigate+screenshot smoke test all passed.
decisions_made: Extended modules/home/core/dotfiles.nix rather than a new claude-mcp.nix module
activation.claudeMcpServers guards mutations with [[ -v DRY_RUN ]] instead of run, since run cannot express jq's > redirection
Kept @playwright/mcp@latest unpinned; smoke test passed cleanly against resolved 0.0.79
